Several days of attempts (each jar takes about 10–80 attempts)

The pharaoh {creature:Horestis} sleeps in his tomb near Ankrahmun, sealed by five {item:Ornate Canopic Jar|Ornate Canopic Jars}. When the players on the server break all five jars, Horestis wakes up and can be fought. The reward of this world change is access to the {creature:Sandstone Scorpion} as a mount.
A pharaoh rests in his tomb, but he can be awakened once more.
Ramp to the Horestis Tomb, outside Ankrahmun
Any level can take part and break the jars; 100+ recommended to walk around the tomb and face Horestis.
You can break all the jars using only the characters of one account.
Potions and equipment to get through the tomb (many creatures guard Horestis).
Access to the {creature:Sandstone Scorpion} as a mount
Each jar you break gives you one chance to face {creature:Horestis}
Reward of this world change: depends on Horestis being woken on your server.
Bring friends or other characters: breaking a jar takes 10–80 attempts on average and each character can only fail once per hour.
Ask any {wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC} about {key:horestis} to find out which stage the world change is at on your server.
Travel to **Ankrahmun** by boat (at the harbour of your city, {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}). Leave **Ankrahmun** and head to the ramp at this spot.

Go up the ramp heading straight **north** and follow the path that goes down into the tombs. You are in the {wiki:Horestis Tomb|Horestis Tomb}, where the pharaoh {creature:Horestis} is protected by many creatures. The entrance is above the dragon spawn closest to Ankrahmun (1 floor above ground level).

There are {creature:Tomb Servant|Tomb Servants}, {creature:Sacred Spider|Sacred Spiders}, {creature:Clay Guardian|Clay Guardians}, {creature:Grave Guard|Grave Guards}, {creature:Death Priest|Death Priests} and {creature:Elder Mummy|Elder Mummies}.
2. Break the five Ornate Canopic Jars

Five {item:Ornate Canopic Jar|Ornate Canopic Jars} seal the burial chamber of Horestis. There is **one jar on each floor** below the floor where {npc:An Ancient Priest} is (floors -1 to -5). You can break the jars in any order.
The five jars are at these spots:
Use the jar. Either you break it, or you hear *"Waaaaaah"* and fail. Each jar takes 10 to 80 attempts on average.
Each broken jar gives you one chance to face Horestis, which you can use whenever you like, even much later.

If you fail, you can only try again **one hour** (real time) later. If you try sooner, you see *"You are too afraid to destroy this object"*. If you manage to break a jar, you can try another one straight away: the waiting time only starts when you fail.
Use several characters (even on the same account) to speed things up.
Once all five jars are broken, {creature:Horestis} wakes up to crush the intruders. Use one of the chances you earned by breaking jars to face him.
Horestis is a boss: go prepared and preferably in a team.
After someone on the server kills Horestis, his teleport stays active until the **next server save**, and the curse hangs over Ankrahmun.
Go back the same way: go up the stairs on each floor of the tomb to the entrance, go down the ramp and return to **Ankrahmun**, where {npc:Captain Sinbeard} has boats to other cities.
4. Find out the state of the world change
Say {key:horestis} to a {wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC}. The answer tells you the current stage:
At least one jar is still unbroken.
The jars are broken but nobody has killed Horestis yet.
Horestis has already been killed; the teleport is active until the next server save.
The world change may start again after the next server save.
